title: Occupancy classification drives system type
requirement: Classify the building occupancy before selecting hydrant, sprinkler, detection and egress provisions. Mixed use follows the more restrictive occupancy for shared fire systems.

title: Yard hydrant coverage
requirement: Provide external yard hydrants so every point of the building envelope is reachable with a standard fire-brigade hose lay. Keep hydrants on hard-standing, clear of parking, and fed from the fire water network.

title: First-aid hose reels
requirement: Install first-aid hose reels so occupants can reach every point of a floor with the hose. Place reels on escape routes, typically near stair lobbies, not inside locked rooms.

title: Wet riser / downcomer
requirement: Provide wet risers or downcomers based on building height. Landing valves at each floor; riser in a fire-rated shaft accessible from the staircase lobby.

title: Automatic sprinklers
requirement: Provide sprinklers where occupancy, height or fire load requires them (typical for large mercantile, assembly, basement parking and high-rise). Space heads for full coverage, including hidden voids if required.

title: Fire water tanks
requirement: Provide underground or terrace tanks sized for the most demanding system (sprinkler + hydrant). Keep suction, fill and overflow arrangements independent of domestic water where required.

title: Fire pumps
requirement: Provide electric main pump, diesel standby and jockey pump as a set, located in a protected pump room with direct access and reliable power / fuel.

title: Portable extinguishers
requirement: Distribute ABC/CO2 extinguishers along escape routes and at electrical rooms, kitchens and parking. Do not substitute extinguishers for required fixed systems.

title: Means of escape
requirement: Keep travel distances, number of exits and corridor/stair widths compliant. Fire systems must not obstruct exits. Place hose reels and extinguishers without reducing required clear width.

title: Basement and parking
requirement: Basements and covered parking typically need sprinklers, hydrants/hose reels, mechanical smoke ventilation and clearly marked vehicle and pedestrian exits.

title: High-rise extra provisions
requirement: For tall residential towers, include wet risers, sprinklers as required by height, fireman's lift, refuge areas, and a dedicated fire pump / tank arrangement.

title: Mercantile sprinkler emphasis
requirement: Shops, malls and storage-adjacent retail assume higher fire load. Prefer full sprinkler coverage, larger tank sizing and hydrants on service roads.

title: Assembly occupant load
requirement: Theatres, halls and similar assembly spaces need extra exits, hose reels on public routes, and hydrant access for fire tenders at the main frontage.

title: Industrial hazard
requirement: Match hydrant spacing and water density to hazard. Isolate process areas, keep pump rooms remote from high-hazard stores, and provide hydrants around the plot boundary.
